name: watch2
description: Let Claude watch a video. Downloads with yt-dlp, transcribes with Qwen3-ASR (or native captions, free), optionally extracts frames with ffmpeg, and writes a timestamped markdown report Claude reads and turns into notes.

interface.shortDescription: Give Claude a video input — paste a URL or path and ask about it.
interface.longDescription: watch adds a skill that lets the agent watch any video: it downloads with yt-dlp, extracts auto-scaled frames with ffmpeg, pulls a timestamped transcript from native captions (or the Whisper API as a fallback), and hands frames + transcript to the model so it can answer questions grounded in what's actually on screen and in the audio.
defaultPrompt: /watch2 https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ what happens at the 30 second mark?

longDescription: watch2 lets the agent watch a video. It pulls a timestamped transcript from the platform's own captions when they exist and from Qwen3-ASR when they do not, optionally extracts scene-aware frames with ffmpeg, and writes a markdown report to disk that the agent reads and turns into notes with timestamps linking back to the source.
